kind: sealed re-run of the P3 absorption bet on the 89-row both-real population; committed BEFORE the stratified-V bet statistic is computed (only the marginal power check preceded this, which reveals resolution, not the bet outcome).
why: The canon-47 P3 run was INSUFFICIENT RESOLUTION (9-19 rows per locality class, within-stratum tables small-sample-inflated to V=1.0). The full both-real population (89 = canon 47 + v3-new 42) has more power and -- critically -- v3-new's para-NP-hard mass finally gives the parameterized column variation.
population: 89 both-real rows (approximation AND parameterized non-sentinel), locality labels from mosaic-locality.jsonl (sha 4c7ef94c, already hashed and committed before this addendum).
contamination_disclosed: This bet is sealed AFTER the canon-47 outcome was known (INSUFFICIENT). Disclosed in full; the mitigation is that the bet FORM is unchanged and the estimator + resolution are fixed here before the statistic is computed.
bet_unchanged_in_form: Conditioning on locality shrinks the pooled UNCONDITIONAL approx<->param V of this 89-row population by >= half. Same shape as prereg_v10 P3; only the population and the (now-fixed, correct) estimator differ.
estimator: structure.stratified_cramers_v -- the pooled within-stratum chi-square conditional association (defect #15 permanent fix, gated by the hardmap-verify known-answer test). NEVER the average of per-class V's.
resolution_declared_by_power_check: INSUFFICIENT RESOLUTION. Power check (locality[3] x approx, Cochran floor >=80% of cells with expected>=5 and all>=1): full-approx 6/21=29% (min-exp 0.1, floor FAILED); collapsed-3-approx (scheme/const-or-log/poly-or-worse) 7/9=78% (min-exp 2.0, ONE cell short of 80%). Without collapsing the param column (not sanctioned), the within-stratum approx x param tables also fail (delocalized n=43 -> ~3.6/cell at 3x4). NEITHER granularity clears the floor.
verdict: INSUFFICIENT RESOLUTION -- declared, run ends at the power check per prereg_v10 kill-criterion 2. The P3 absorption bet is NOT scored HIT or MISS on this population. Finding: the within-locality absorption test waits for the next expansion's both-real recruitment (89 rows, three locality classes, is below the floor; the collapsed-3 result at 78% suggests it is close, so a modest further expansion may cross it).
descriptive_still_printed: Three-population within-stratum V (canon-47 / v3-new-42 / pooled-89) reported DESCRIPTIVELY with the INSUFFICIENT caveat (standing three-population law), and the P2 asymmetry pair re-computed on the 89 rows as a descriptive, adequately-powered look at the two-property split -- both labeled descriptive, neither scored.
